newsitem.title: USA: Cardiodynamics cleared to market BioZ.
newsitem.headline: Cardiodynamics cleared to market BioZ.

text.p: CardioDynamics International Corp Tuesday said it received marketing clearance from the U.S. Food and Drug Administration to market its BioZ noninvasive hemodynamic monitoring system.
The company said it will start marketing the product immediately.
It did not say how soon sales of BioZ would contribute to the company's earnings, or how much that contribution would be.
Officials from CardioDynamics were not immediately available to comment.
